Furthermore, the absence of a T2-FLAIR mismatch sign argues strongly against an IDH-mutant astrocytoma. The FLAIR transition zone is also very sharp, which is more typical for IDH-wildtype tumors. The large volume of associated edema also supports this conclusion. The combination of these imaging features strongly outweighs the demographic information.
